format.description: Format of the API backend. Use 'openai' for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (Ollama, vLLM, etc.). Use 'anthropic' for Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

baseURL.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. 'http://localhost:11434/v1' for Ollama, 'http://localhost:1234/v1' for LM Studio).

endpointType.description: Local-LLM server type (replaces the old baseURL autodetect). 'ollama' = model discovery + VRAM-footprint probe + unload-between-models. 'lm-studio' = enriched discovery (context length, quantization) + unload-between-models — but no VRAM-footprint probe, which LM Studio's REST API doesn't support. 'unknown' = a generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. vLLM). OpenRouter is detected by URL regardless of this setting.

allowInsecureHttp.description: Allow http:// base URLs for non-localhost hosts (e.g. Ollama or LM Studio on your LAN). Use only on trusted private networks.

free.description: This endpoint is a free, local LLM (e.g. Ollama/LM Studio). When on, the model picker hides pricing and shows model size/VRAM footprint instead (VRAM probing is Ollama-only), and the module is treated as free (cost tier "free"). Turn off for a paid generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

model.description: Model ID to use. Left blank until live discovery selects the cheapest model.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort level (if supported by provider)

batchMode.description: Batch by target language or by entry

useStructuredOutput.description: openai format only (ignored when format is 'anthropic'). Force JSON-array output via a response_format schema. For grammar-constrained backends (Ollama/llama.cpp) this makes malformed replies (objects, code fences, wrong types) impossible — the main cause of 'malformed JSON from provider' on small local models. Only enable if your endpoint honors response_format; leave off for endpoints that reject it.

rateLimitEnabled.description: Apply the global requests-per-second limit to this endpoint. Off by default — local Ollama/LM Studio endpoints do not need throttling.

maxParallel.description: Maximum provider requests run at once for this endpoint (1 = serial). Keep at 1 for a single local LLM; raise for a fast paid API. Applies to all of this endpoint's work — translation, AI review, and glossary suggestions.
